titleEs: Mobalytics D4 vs Icy Veins D4 — visual moderno o prosa enciclopedia
titleEn: Mobalytics D4 vs Icy Veins D4 — modern visual or encyclopedia prose
descriptionEs: Ambos cubren guides y tier lists pero con formatos opuestos. Mobalytics es visual cards modernas; Icy Veins es long-form prose enciclopedia.
descriptionEn: Both cover guides and tier lists but with opposite formats. Mobalytics is modern visual cards; Icy Veins is encyclopedia-style long-form prose.
verdictEs: Mobalytics si quieres visual moderna y quick scan. Icy Veins si preferís lectura prose long-form sin video distractions. Ambos competitive pero a audiencias diferentes.
verdictEn: Mobalytics if you want modern visual and quick scan. Icy Veins if you prefer long-form prose reading without video distractions. Both competitive but to different audiences.

useCases.labelEs: Visual scan rápido de tier list
useCases.reasonEs: Mobalytics presenta tier lists con badges S/A/B/C en grid visible at-a-glance. Icy Veins tiene tier lists pero embedded en prose, requiere reading.
useCases.reasonEn: Mobalytics presents tier lists with S/A/B/C badges in at-a-glance grid. Icy Veins has tier lists but embedded in prose, requires reading.

useCases.reasonEs: Icy Veins prose deep es pure text, ideal para learners que prefieren leer sobre ver. Mobalytics simplifica a cards que pierden context narrativo.
useCases.reasonEn: Icy Veins deep prose is pure text, ideal for learners who prefer reading over watching. Mobalytics simplifies to cards that lose narrative context.

useCases.reasonEs: Icy Veins es la referencia default para WoW players. Migrating a D4 mantiene formato familiar. Mobalytics tiene mejor brand en MOBAs (LoL).
useCases.reasonEn: Icy Veins is the default reference for WoW players. Migrating to D4 keeps the familiar format. Mobalytics has better brand in MOBAs (LoL).

useCases.reasonEs: Mobalytics UI visual moderna funciona bien en mobile. Icy Veins long pages de prose son rough en pantalla chica.
useCases.reasonEn: Mobalytics' modern visual UI works well on mobile. Icy Veins' long prose pages are rough on small screens.

useCases.reasonEs: Mobalytics post-patch update suele estar listo en 24-48h. Icy Veins tarda 3-5 días en revisar full prose content.
useCases.reasonEn: Mobalytics post-patch update tends to be ready in 24-48h. Icy Veins takes 3-5 days to revise full prose content.
